summary: Sanders County, MT 50-foot pole L-4 tower on the Flathead Indian Reservation, dated 1935 and destroyed 1961; a July 1959 item names its lookout. No source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Destroyed in 1961 per firelookout.com; the Montana list also marks it gone

events.note: firelookout.com dates the 50-foot pole L-4 tower to 1935
July 1959 item, cited to Char-Koosta, reports Louie Parker on the Vanderburg tower in the Flathead Agency District
firelookout.com gives 1961 as the year the tower was destroyed

evidence.supports: location on the Flathead Indian Reservation
Sanders County; Flathead Indian Agency district; township 18N, range 24W, section 13

evidence.quote: In Flathead Agency District, Louie Parker on Vanderburg Tower.

notes_for_editor: Two detailed pages and the Montana list agree the tower is gone. Firelookout.com gives 1935 and 1961. The 1959 staffing item is quoted second-hand from Char-Koosta on the Forest Lookouts page; the original was not seen. The agency comes from the Forest Lookouts location line (Flathead Indian Agency district); it is not a stated operator, and the brief had no agency. No site description, cause of loss or access information found, so access is omitted. Height 15.2 m is the 50-foot figure converted.
